subject: S12a follow-ups: time async continuations; page-wide picture caps
body: 1) Wrap the engine's async continuations (settle encode/decode .then, restoreParked img.decode().then, encode worker onmessage) in timed(), or add a longtask PerformanceObserver bound during scroll rounds; extend the negative test with a 12 ms microtask regression that must fail. 2) Make MAX_PARKED_BYTES and MAX_SLABS_PIXELS page-wide like CanvasBudget (before S15 mounts many tall PDF surfaces). 3) Note WebKit's 1 ms timer resolution in the gate comment. Full gate; CI green.
acceptance: negative microtask test fails the gate; caps page-wide; CI green
